abilities.critical_failure: The creature is confused for 1 round.
abilities.critical_success: The creature is invigorated by the atmosphere and is quickened for 1 round.
abilities.effect: The triggering creature must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save. The hazard then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Poisonous Atmosphere

traits.name: Illusion
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the illusion school of magic, typically involving false sensory stimuli.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target's mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text: This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.

abilities.trigger: A non-native creature breathes the atmosphere

hazard.description: Aucturn’s poisonous, magical atmosphere has strange efects on the planet’s creatures.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Survival (trained) or Occultism (trained) to breathe pockets of safe air trapped in bags and clothing
hazard.name: Poisonous Atmosphere
hazard.routine: (1 action; illusion, mental, occult) The atmosphere continues to affect all creatures in the area, requiring a new Fortitude save each round against its Poisonous Atmosphere (above). A creature holding its breath gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the save.
hazard.stealth: +5 (expert) to identify the source of sudden nausea

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text:
Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. A magical item radiates a magic aura infused with its dominant school of magic.  
  
 Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target's mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text: An effect with this trait delivers a poison or deals poison damage. An item with this trait is poisonous and might cause an affliction.
